Recorded claim:
D324852 queues row-count/invalidation notifications through `_jsTree` during `beginUpdateBatch`, flushes per animation frame and at `endUpdateBatch`, and must preserve `TreeSelection.adjustSelection` mutation order while avoiding repeated redraws. `restoreSelection` intentionally uses `suppressUpdates`/`resumeUpdates` because expansion notifications are discarded before rebuilding selection. [Task 1]
